closet.why: OUR shelf, not the format's: zoroark is isNonstandard:null and legal to bring. ROADMAP #160 — Illusion is in the closet because a body pretending to be another body makes every divergence it causes unreadable as a rule defect. Derived from the ABILITY so a carrier added next regulation is covered without an edit. THE RULE IS APPLIED TO THE SHEET AND THE BATTLE BRINGS ONLY THE FIRST 4 BUILDABLE BODIES, so a team whose carrier sits past that index is dropped for a body that never enters either engine (see carrier_sheet_slot). Narrowing the rule would CHANGE THE SAMPLE and therefore the headline rate, so it is declared here and owed, not done quietly.
